prompt: At the stop, the driver told us our tram (to be) ten minutes late.
explanation_ru: После глагола в прошедшем времени (told) настоящее время сдвигается в Past Simple (is → was).

prompt: My dad opened the fridge and said the shelves ___ full of drinks.
explanation_ru: После глагола said в прошедшем времени нужен сдвиг в Past Simple, а с подлежащим shelves во множественном числе используется were. Типичная ошибка — оставить are или поставить was.

prompt: Our hotel owner says breakfast (to start) at seven, but the café isn't open.
explanation_ru: Вводящий глагол стоит в настоящем времени (says), поэтому сдвига времён не происходит — остаётся Present Simple (starts).

prompt: During the cooking class in Mexico, Sofia promised she (will / to show) us the sauce recipe once we finished the onions.
explanation_ru: После глагола promised в прошедшем времени will переходит в would (would show).

prompt: On Tuesday I rushed my green parrot to a local vet clinic. After checking the bird, the nurse explained that it (to eat) a plastic button before our visit. She warned me that my pet (will / to need) an X-ray right away. Luckily, she added that I (can / to take) him home the same evening. When we got back, the noisy bird immediately tried to bite another shirt.
explanation_ru: Событие до визита после explained переходит в Past Perfect (had eaten), будущее после warned — в would need, а модальный can после added — в could take.

prompt: Looking at the sky, the farmer told us the field (to be) too dry.
explanation_ru: После глагола told в прошедшем времени форма is сдвигается в Past Simple — was.

prompt: After lunch our designer said she is too tired to finish the poster.
answer: After lunch our designer said she was too tired to finish the poster.
accepted_answers: After lunch our designer said she was too tired to finish the poster.
After lunch our designer said that she was too tired to finish the poster.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — оставить настоящее время (is) после глагола в прошедшем (said). По правилу согласования времён нужно заменить is на was.

prompt: The cake looked huge. My cousin told me it ___ the door.
explanation_ru: После глагола told в прошедшем времени описание переходит в Past Simple (was taller than). Ошибка — оставить настоящее время (is) или выбрать будущее.

prompt: Paola told the station manager that a traveller (to leave) a suitcase full of rubber ducks by noon.
explanation_ru: Действие завершилось к определённому моменту в прошлом (by noon) ещё до рассказа, поэтому в косвенной речи используется Past Perfect (had left).

prompt: Our music teacher said, "The song starts with the boys, not the girls." → Our music teacher explained …
answer: Our music teacher explained that the song started with the boys, not the girls.
accepted_answers: Our music teacher explained that the song started with the boys, not the girls.
Our music teacher explained the song started with the boys, not the girls.
explanation_ru: После вводящего глагола в прошедшем времени (explained) Present Simple прямой речи (starts) сдвигается в Past Simple (started); союз that можно опустить.

prompt: Tension rose backstage at the Seoul TV studio before the evening show. The director announced that the studio (to look) completely ready for the live broadcast. Seconds later, his assistant whispered that the main guest (to miss) her flight earlier. Everyone stared in silence because nobody (can / to reach) her agent by phone.
explanation_ru: Состояние на момент речи после announced сдвигается в Past Simple (looked), более раннее событие — в Past Perfect (had missed), а can в прошлом контексте — в could reach.

prompt: Marta shouted that she (to find) a huge old tooth in the sand.
explanation_ru: В прямой речи действие только что свершилось (Present Perfect: have found), поэтому после глагола shouted в прошедшем времени оно переходит в Past Perfect (had found).

prompt: The sky turned grey, and my neighbour warned us it (to rain) soon.
explanation_ru: Прогноз на будущее после глагола в прошедшем времени (warned) передаётся через would + инфинитив (would rain) или конструкцию was going to rain.

prompt: During our science class, Aino tells me her water ___ bright green.
explanation_ru: Вводящий глагол tells стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому сдвига времён нет — остаётся Present Continuous (is turning). Ошибка — автоматически перевести глагол в прошедшее время.

prompt: Smiling beside his grill, the stall owner promised he (to cook) our fish fresh once we (to choose) one.
explanation_ru: После promised обещание на будущее передаётся через would cook, а глагол в придаточном времени после once сдвигается в прошедшее время (chose или had chosen).

prompt: When I popped into the neighbourhood chemist in Sofia, the shelves were nearly bare. Zara explained that the popular cold tablets (to sell) out before midday. However, she assured me that a fresh delivery (to arrive) the following morning. She also mentioned that customers (not / to need) a doctor's note for the herbal syrup she recommended instead. I bought a bottle on the spot and thanked her for the tip.
explanation_ru: Предшествующее событие передаётся в Past Perfect (had sold), запланированная поставка — через would arrive (или was arriving / was going to arrive), а постоянное правило в прошлом рассказе — через Past Simple (did not need).

prompt: The job applicant said me she was feeling completely calm, then dropped her folder across the floor.
answer: The job applicant told me she was feeling completely calm, then dropped her folder across the floor.
accepted_answers: The job applicant told me she was feeling completely calm, then dropped her folder across the floor.
The job applicant told me that she was feeling completely calm, then dropped her folder across the floor.
The job applicant said to me she was feeling completely calm, then dropped her folder across the floor.
The job applicant said to me that she was feeling completely calm, then dropped her folder across the floor.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить дополнение сразу после said (said me). Нужен либо глагол tell без предлога (told me), либо предлог to (said to me).

prompt: Standing in a queue in Tokyo, Kenji told a stranger, "I've heard the new games machine runs out of battery in an hour."
options: Kenji told a stranger he has heard the new machine runs out of battery in an hour.
Kenji said a stranger he had heard the new machine ran out of battery in an hour.
Kenji told a stranger he had heard the new machine ran out of battery in an hour.
Kenji told a stranger he had heard the new machine will run out of battery in an hour.
explanation_ru: После глагола told в прошедшем времени Present Perfect (have heard) переходит в Past Perfect (had heard), а Present Simple (runs) — в Past Simple (ran). В остальных вариантах допущены ошибки: отсутствие сдвига, said без to и сохранение will.

prompt: While we waited by the ferry café, word went round that our boat (to sail) two hours late.
explanation_ru: Пассажиры ещё ждали отправления, поэтому будущее действие с точки зрения прошлого передаётся формой would sail (также подходят was going to sail и was sailing).

prompt: Did the librarian warn you that the history section ___ early for roof repairs?
explanation_ru: Вводящий глагол стоит в прошедшем времени (Did ... warn), поэтому предупреждение о будущем закрытии передаётся формой would close. Типичная ошибка — оставить will close или Present Simple.

prompt: Three children pressed their noses against the Rotterdam toy shop window. An assistant smiled and explained that the delivery van (to sit) in heavy traffic nearby. She promised she (to unpack) the new wooden trains as soon as the driver parked outside. Hearing that, the oldest boy sighed that he (not / to bring) enough pocket money with him.
explanation_ru: Действие в процессе на тот момент переходит в Past Continuous (was sitting), обещание — в would unpack, а отсутствие денег, случившееся ранее, — в Past Perfect (had not brought).

prompt: Beatriz stands at the Rio airport desk with a damaged grey suitcase. She tells the clerk that her bag (to have) only three wheels now. Earlier at the gate, a staff member admitted that a loader (to drop) it off the trolley. He also promised that the desk staff (to give) her a replacement bag.
explanation_ru: После tells в настоящем времени сдвига нет (has), а после глаголов в прошедшем (admitted, promised) предшествующее действие переходит в Past Perfect (had dropped), а обещание — в would give.

prompt: The caretaker promised that the old lift would work by Friday, yet nobody in our block believed him.
answer: The caretaker promised that the old lift would work by Friday, yet nobody in our block believed him.
accepted_answers: The caretaker promised that the old lift would work by Friday, yet nobody in our block believed him.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: после глагола promised в прошедшем времени будущее обещание верно передано формой would work.

prompt: Over tea in Glasgow, Moira mentioned that the centre's old dance class always (to end) with a hat prize.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о прежних занятиях после глагола mentioned в прошедшем времени, поэтому регулярное действие передаётся в Past Simple (ended).

prompt: Speaking to a local reporter near Izmir, the assistant explained that the ancient stone floor (to remain) damp because heavy rain (to flood) the site overnight.
explanation_ru: После глагола explained текущее на тот момент состояние передаётся в Past Simple (remained), а предшествующая причина — в Past Perfect (had flooded).

prompt: Between rounds at the library chess club, everyone noticed that the top seed's chair was still empty. A player next to me whispered that Lukas (to spend) twenty minutes trapped in the old library lift. Even worse, she added that his mobile phone (to have) no signal inside the metal box. Before the caretaker finally freed him, the referee warned us that the match (to continue) without him. Minutes later, Lukas rushed in, breathless, and somehow won the game anyway.
explanation_ru: Предшествующее событие в лифте переходит в Past Perfect (had spent), состояние телефона — в Past Simple (had), а предупреждение о будущем действии — в would continue.

prompt: In our building's group chat, a worried resident claimed that someone on the third floor (to keep) a pet snake that (to escape) from its glass tank a week earlier.
explanation_ru: После глагола claimed постоянный факт передаётся в Past Simple или Past Continuous (kept / was keeping), а побег, произошедший раньше, — в Past Perfect (had escaped).

prompt: Although nobody believed the rumour at first, shoppers in the food hall insisted that the new noodle stall ___ its secret recipe even if rivals offered a fortune.
explanation_ru: После глагола insisted в прошедшем времени отказ на будущее передаётся через would (would never share). Типичная ошибка — оставить will или настоящее время.

prompt: After the local contest in Ottawa, club members whispered that the winner has found her famous soup recipe inside an old second-hand notebook.
answer: After the local contest in Ottawa, club members whispered that the winner had found her famous soup recipe inside an old second-hand notebook.
accepted_answers: After the local contest in Ottawa, club members whispered that the winner had found her famous soup recipe inside an old second-hand notebook.
After the local contest in Ottawa, club members whispered the winner had found her famous soup recipe inside an old second-hand notebook.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — оставить Present Perfect (has found) после глагола в прошедшем времени (whispered). Форма должна сдвинуться в Past Perfect (had found).

prompt: Before retiring in Cairo, the elderly artist told me that his hand often (to shake), though a small bag of rice (to help) him steady the brush for decades.
explanation_ru: После глагола told регулярное действие в прошлом передаётся в Past Simple (shook), а действие, длившееся до этого момента десятилетиями (for decades), переходит из Present Perfect в Past Perfect (had helped).

prompt: Over lunch in the factory canteen, Minh overheard two machine operators discussing big plans. The first operator claimed that the factory urgently (to require) twenty new workers. His colleague added that the boss (to sign) a huge export deal a week earlier. They even swore that the extra shifts (to pay) double rates from March. Strangely, nobody in the office has posted a single job advert yet.
explanation_ru: Текущая потребность завода после claimed передаётся в Past Simple (required), подписанная ранее сделка — в Past Perfect (had signed), а будущая оплата — через would pay.

prompt: At an institute in Bangalore, a colleague told Ravi, "That old basement printer can handle any language, though nobody has ever switched it on."
options: A colleague told Ravi that the old basement printer can handle any language, though nobody had ever switched it on.
A colleague told Ravi that the old basement printer could handle any language, though nobody had ever switched it on.
A colleague said Ravi that the old basement printer could handle any language, though nobody had ever switched it on.
A colleague told Ravi that the old basement printer could handle any language, though nobody ever switched it on.
explanation_ru: После глагола told в прошедшем времени can переходит в could, а Present Perfect (has ever switched) — в Past Perfect (had ever switched). В остальных вариантах допущены ошибки: нет сдвига у can, пропущен предлог после said или потерян Past Perfect.
